```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(collapse)
```

```{r}
model_df <- sa_full_norm%>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()


## Focus on URBAN DATA:
df_urban <- model_df%>%filter(urban_rural%in%"Urban")

# 1. Prepare data:

df_urban <- df_urban%>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category),
    county = factor(COUNTY_ENGLISH),
    urban_area = factor(SA_URBAN_AREA_NAME),
    log_places_density = log1p(places_density_km2),
    log_area = log1p(area_km2),
    z_log_places_density = as.numeric(scale(log_places_density)),
    z_log_area = as.numeric(scale(log_area)),
    z_target_pop_norm = as.numeric(scale(target_pop_norm)),
    krig_se = sqrt(krig_var)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(krig_value),
    !is.na(category),
    !is.na(z_log_places_density),
    !is.na(z_log_area),
    !is.na(z_target_pop_norm),
    !is.na(county),
    !is.na(urban_area)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}

# Calculate outcome scale for sensible priors
y_mean <- mean(df_urban$krig_value, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sd   <- sd(df_urban$krig_value, na.rm = TRUE)

# Define priors
priors <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 50)", class = "b"),
  set_prior(paste0("normal(", y_mean, ", ", 2 * y_sd, ")"), class = "Intercept"),
  set_prior(paste0("exponential(", 1 / y_sd, ")"), class = "sigma"),
  set_prior("exponential(0.02)", class = "sd"),
  set_prior("gamma(2, 0.1)", class = "nu")
)


model_urban <- brm(
  formula = krig_value ~ category + z_log_places_density  
     + (1 | county),
  data = df_urban,
  family = student(),
  prior = priors,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15)
)
```
```{r}
# Evaluate model

summary(model_urban)
plot(model_urban)
pp_check(model_urban)
bayes_R2(model_urban)
loo(model_urban)
```

```{r}
## Marginal plots

# 1. Main categorical plot
plot_predictions(
  model_urban,
  condition = "category",
  re_formula = NA
)

# 2. Main continuous predictor plot
plot_predictions(
  model_urban,
  condition = "z_log_places_density",
  re_formula = NA # take notes 
)

# 3. Density by category
plot_predictions(
  model_urban,
  condition = c("z_log_places_density", "category"),
  re_formula = NA
)
```

```{r}
# Repeat the same for rural areas:

df_rural <- model_df%>%filter(urban_rural%in%"Rural")

# 1. Prepare data:

df_rural <- df_rural%>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category),
    county = factor(COUNTY_ENGLISH),
    urban_area = factor(SA_URBAN_AREA_NAME),
    log_places_density = log1p(places_density_km2),
    log_area = log1p(area_km2),
    z_log_places_density = as.numeric(scale(log_places_density)),
    z_log_area = as.numeric(scale(log_area)),
    z_target_pop_norm = as.numeric(scale(target_pop_norm)),
    krig_se = sqrt(krig_var)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(krig_value),
    !is.na(category),
    !is.na(z_log_places_density),
    !is.na(z_log_area),
    !is.na(z_target_pop_norm),
    !is.na(county),
    !is.na(urban_area)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


# Calculate outcome scale for sensible priors
y_mean_rural <- mean(df_rural$krig_value, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sd_rural  <- sd(df_rural$krig_value, na.rm = TRUE)

# Define priors
priors_rural <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 50)", class = "b"),
  set_prior(paste0("normal(", y_mean_rural, ", ", 2 * y_sd, ")"), class = "Intercept"),
  set_prior(paste0("exponential(", 1 / y_sd_rural, ")"), class = "sigma"),
  set_prior("exponential(0.02)", class = "sd"),
  set_prior("gamma(2, 0.1)", class = "nu")
)

model_rural <- brm(
  formula = krig_value ~ category + z_log_places_density + z_log_area +
    z_target_pop_norm + (1 | county) + (1 | urban_area),
  data = df_rural,
  family = student(),
  prior = priors_rural,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 1000,
  seed = 123,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15)
)
```

```{r}
# Evaluate model

summary(model_rural)
plot(model_rural)
pp_check(model_rural)
bayes_R2(model_rural)
loo(model_rural)


# Marginal plots rural
# 1. Main categorical plot
plot_predictions(
  model_rural,
  condition = "category",
  re_formula = NA
)

# 2. Main continuous predictor plot
plot_predictions(
  model_rural,
  condition = "z_log_places_density",
  re_formula = NA
)

# 3. Density by category
plot_predictions(
  model_rural,
  condition = c("z_log_places_density", "category"),
  re_formula = NA
)
```
